sentences.ar: بضيعة بعيدة عن البحر، عاش ولد اسمه ماجد.
sentences.en: In a village far from the sea, lived a boy named Majid.

sentences.ar: ماجد ما كان شاف البحر بحياته.
sentences.en: Majid had never seen the sea in his life.

sentences.ar: بس كان يحلم فيه كل ليلة.
sentences.en: But he dreamed of it every night.

sentences.ar: جده حكاله عن البحر، عن زرقته واتساعه.
sentences.en: His grandfather told him about the sea, its blueness and vastness.

sentences.ar: ماجد قال: يوم من الأيام، رح أشوف البحر.
sentences.en: Majid said: one day, I will see the sea.

sentences.ar: كبر ماجد، واشتغل وجمع مصاري شوي شوي.
sentences.en: Majid grew up, worked, and saved money little by little.

sentences.en: The sea was bigger and more beautiful than all his dreams.

sentences.ar: نزل عالمي، وحس ببرودتها على قدميه.

sentences.ar: ضحك متل الولاد، وصرخ من الفرح.
sentences.en: He laughed like children, and shouted from joy.
